sql: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(q),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id,owner,owner_id,version,metadata->>'size' AS size,metadata->>'mimetype' AS mime,metadata->>'eTag' AS etag FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id='operation-evidence' AND name='ba40a958-0747-4751-9b33-b3326bf7b802/5ba488bb-8144-4899-ac1b-46890127ff76/revoked.png') q;
